wellbeing.compositionDescription: The full ring represents 100 points. Colored segments show each axis contribution; the background shows the gap to full satisfaction.
wellbeing.satisfactionDescription: Four axes and their average for evaluated resident households. City-score accident penalties are excluded.
wellbeing.leisureDescription: Free time and working hours use the right axis; leisure and satisfaction use the left. Less time reduces leisure spending.
wellbeing.comfortDescription: Housing space, quietness, sunlight and safety determine comfort. Housing adequacy is displayed up to 100%.
wellbeing.workDescription: Labor output scales with an 8-hour baseline. Longer hours reduce leisure; sustained work above 8 hours harms health. Applies from the next simulation.
